Salesforce Admin Practice Exam

Try these practice questions. They are written for study and are not actual exam content.

What does an organization-wide default (OWD) control?

Not quite.

Organization-wide defaults set the baseline level of access to records.

You open access up further with the role hierarchy, sharing rules, and manual sharing.

Which tool lets an admin automate a record-triggered process without code?

Flow handles record-triggered automation declaratively (no code).
